grade_reason: No statement by him about AI since January 2025 was found in his official press releases or in seven web searches, so there is nothing to grade. His AI-related work found (a 2018 hearing statement, a 2020 national AI strategy resolution, a 2024 letter to Meta on AI and election misinformation) is all before 2025.
notes: All six required web searches ran this time, plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (7 in total); none returned a 2025-2026 statement by Veasey on AI risk, superintelligence, extinction, a pause or slowdown, or China talks. Older AI material outside the date range: 2018 opening statement as ranking member at a House Science AI hearing (democrats-science.house.gov), 2020 bipartisan resolution with Rep. Robin Kelly for a national AI strategy, 2024 letter he led to Meta on AI and election disinformation (veasey.house.gov). Official press release listing (https://veasey.house.gov/media-center/press-releases) was opened again; the earlier run covered 14 January 2025 to 16 September 2026, and the newest page (to 13 November 2026) adds no release about AI (the 13 November 2026 release is a cybersecurity clinics grant bill, not AI). Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538): sources found name only Ocasio-Cortez among about nine House cosponsors and do not mention Veasey; Congress.gov cosponsor page returned HTTP 403, so his status could not be confirmed either way. A search hit, the 2025 hearing transcript CHRG-119hhrg60129 on congress.gov, lists him on a committee roster but was too large to open, so any remarks he made there were not checked. Hearing remarks, floor speeches and interviews were only covered to the extent web search surfaced them.
